address: calle dei Fabbri 4685, sestiere San Marco, Venice, 30124, Italy
bio: In the heart of the city, just a few steps from St. Mark's Square and Rialto, the fine restaurant Bistrot de Venise will surprise you with Venetian cuisine that combines tradition and innovation. Both past and current dishes are reinterpreted with a contemporary twist, offering a unique dining experience. Wine lovers will be delighted by the selection of Italian rarities, perfect to accompany each course....
